appDir.description: Absolute path of the folder that holds the web app. The page may load only files inside it.

page.description: The page to open, relative to appDir. Default: index.html

clicks.description: CSS selectors to click, in order, after the page has loaded (searched in the page and its frames). Optional. Runs before steps.

steps.description: A script to drive the page with, in order. Each entry names exactly one action: {"click": selector} · {"fill": selector, "value": text} · {"check": selector} · {"uncheck": selector} · {"select": selector, "value": option} · {"wait": milliseconds} · {"reload": true} · {"expectText": text} · {"expectNoText": text} · {"expectValue": selector, "value": text} (a checkbox reads "true" or "false"). A failed step is reported and the script goes on. To check that a page saves: change something, press its connect/save control, reload, and expect the change to still be there.

saveFolder.description: Set this when the page saves with the browser's folder picker (showDirectoryPicker). No person is there to pick a folder, so the check hands the page one: "app" = the app's own folder (appDir), "other" = an empty folder that is not the app's, to see that the page refuses it. Nothing is written to disk — what the page writes is kept aside, listed in the report, and served back to the page, so a reload step shows what it saved.
